name: Easy Spinach Salad with Sheet Pan Chicken, Sweet Potato, Cauliflower, Apricots & Pistachios

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE ROASTED CHICKEN & VEGGIES: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Wash, dry, peel, and medium dice sweet potatoes. Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Divide sweet potato, onion, and cauliflower between two baking sheet pans.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g sweet potato
2 (283 g) bag cauliflower florets

instructions.primary_message: Large dice chicken. Add to the baking sheets with the veggies, then drizzle with oil and sprinkle with spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pumpkin spice mix
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until veggies are fork-tender and chicken is cooked through, about 40 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
FOR THE SALAD: While the chicken and veggies are cooling, wash and dry the spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place in a large bowl.
Using a clean cutting board, roughly chop apricots and pistachios. Add both to the bowl with the spinach, along with dressing, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup pistachios, unsalted
⅓ cup lemon garlic vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, then top with roasted chicken and veggies. Enjoy!
